en.quote: We have no doubt that in 2009 we will complete the GLONASS system with 24 satellites.
en.head: The full constellation was achieved only in 2011.
en.body: Published GLONASS chronology lists 22 operational satellites in 2010 and a full constellation of 24 in 2011. The 2009 deadline was missed. This comparison concerns the number of satellites, not the quality of navigation coverage.
